_README: Permission policy for Literature_KB, enforcing the file rules in SCHEMA.md.
Claude may add/rename/edit/delete in concepts/ (not concepts/.obsidian/), edit LLM_NOTES.md,
and append to PROGRESS.md. Everything else is read-only. Only a human can change this file.
ENFORCED: the Edit/Write/NotebookEdit/Read path rules, and the 'ask' prompts. Both were
tested and confirmed working on 2026/08/20.
ADVISORY ONLY: the Bash(...) deny list. It matches command names and prefixes, so 'unlink'
slips past a blocked 'rm', and redirection ('cat x > articles/y') is invisible to it.
Do not mistake it for a boundary.
THE GAP: shell commands bypass the path rules entirely, and nothing available on this
machine closes it. MANUAL MODE is the mitigation - every shell command is shown to the
human before it runs. disableAutoMode below enforces that instead of trusting memory.
rm and mv are 'ask' rather than 'deny' because SCHEMA.md grants delete/rename rights in
concepts/, and denying rm only hid deletions behind unlink. A prompt makes them visible.
DO NOT RE-ADD - both were tried on 2026/08/20 and removed. A sandbox block: the Windows
sandbox is unavailable on this machine, and with failIfUnavailable=true it stopped Claude
Code from starting at all. Custom autoMode.hard_deny rules: they blocked nothing in
testing, and they bind only while auto mode is active, which is now disabled here.
Shell history is denied below: no use in this work, and it often holds pasted credentials.
The denies for other directories MUST use absolute paths. The relative form (e.g.,
../Literature/**) only prompts - it does not block. Verified 2026/08/27.
